messages:
nina: :rotating_light: Root: Were seeing duplicate webhook deliveries and delayed fanout for customers on eu1 (webhook-fanout cluster). First alerts at ~15:10 UTC. Some customers report multiple callback POSTs ~3-5x and elevated latency. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2098765432

oncall-bot: Alert: webhook-fanout-delivery-err > 1.2% and avg fanout latency > 2s across eu1 pool. Paging @owen and @webhook-svc.

owen: Quick triage: the fanout worker pool hit a slow path when SQS-backed retry backoff overlapped with a transient DB write spike for delivery checkpoints. Delivery checkpoint writes timed out and workers retried, but dedupe header was only added after the checkpoint write completed -> duplicates on retry.

webhook-svc: Mitigation steps applied at 15:18 UTC: 1) paused non-critical retry queues to drain in-flight messages, 2) enabled strict pre-send-idempotency (adds X-Redwood-Dedupe-ID before attempting delivery), 3) scaled fanout workers + raised checkpoint write timeout.

nina: Impact: downstream systems may have received duplicate callbacks for about 22 customers; customers using exactly-once semantics are most affected. Some time-sensitive webhooks saw 2-6s delivery delays while retries occurred. No payload corruption.

cs: Draft customer comms: "We detected intermittent duplicate webhook deliveries and increased delivery latency in eu1. Weve applied mitigations to reduce retries and added safeguards. We recommend consumers dedupe on X-Redwood-Dedupe-ID. We will follow up with a postmortem." Ready to send to impacted list after verification.

ops: Canary metrics: duplicate rate dropped from 3.9% -> 0.2% within 6m after the pre-send-idempotency flag. Fanout p50 latency returned to baseline.

own: Ops command to toggle pre-send-idempotency (internal):

```
# enable pre-send idempotency flag for eu1 (ops only)
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood.ai/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"webhook.pre_send_idempotency","region":"eu1","enabled":true}'
```

webhook-svc: Next actions: 1) backfill checkpoint writes for suspected duplicate windows to mark processed deliveries, 2) make dedupe header generation synchronous before any retry logic, 3) add alerting for missing dedupe-id on outgoing POSTs, 4) update playbook. Postmortem owners: @owen (cause + fix) and @karen (playbook + comms). ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow.

oncall-bot: Severity downgraded to S3 at 15:30 UTC. Monitoring active.

nina: Note: customers CUST-142, CUST-827, and CUST-901 were contacted at 15:40 UTC. Please escalate if any of those open tickets indicate ongoing duplication.

own: Temporary customer workaround: instruct consumers to dedupe on X-Redwood-Dedupe-ID or on idempotency keys. We also published SDK patch v1.8.2 that surfaces the header for ingestion.

ops: Scheduled maintenance window to rollout synchronous dedupe header generation at 18:00 UTC with 5m canary. Please add objections in next 10m.

nina: Thanks team. Keep an eye on alerts and update this thread if anything regresses. End of broadcast. :white_check_mark:
